source_description: User screenshot: ENTRY LONG; EMA50 cross EMA200; risk-to-reward ratio; daily timeframe. EMA50 marked red and EMA200 grey.
interpretation_notes: Enter only on a fresh daily EMA50 crosses_above EMA200 event.
Signal is evaluated on bar close and executed at the next daily bar open.
The image does not specify stop-loss distance or numeric reward-to-risk, so those are explicitly assumption-based variations.
Predeclared reference: 5% entry-relative stop and 2R target; grid: 3%, 5%, 8% stops and 1R, 1.5R, 2R, 3R targets.
Spot and long-only are used; no shorting, leverage, funding, or liquidation is simulated.
Download includes daily candles from 2017-08-17 for EMA200 warm-up; performance analysis begins 2018-04-01.

costs.source_or_basis: Binance regular-user spot fee baseline 0.10% per side; 10 bps slippage is a modelling assumption, not measured fill.
